scientific_evidence_role: engineering API and feasibility evidence only; no lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is eligible

worldmemarena_interface.attachment_boundary: Text-only methods ingest the frozen attachment caption with image_id and source provenance in text/metadata; they never receive credit for native image-memory support.

adapter_mapping.reset: Construct a new Memoryos instance against a fresh per-run storage directory; no backend reset API exists.
adapter_mapping.ingest_turn: Preserve ordered turns and pair one user turn with the next assistant turn before calling add_memory. Append attachment captions plus image_id provenance to the turn text because meta_data is accepted but discarded by the official implementation.
adapter_mapping.end_session: Flush only a complete pending user/assistant pair. Do not call force_mid_term_analysis because it changes the official heat-trigger lifecycle.
adapter_mapping.snapshot_memories: Normalize all persisted short-term, mid-term, user-long-term, and assistant-long-term records without altering the source files.
adapter_mapping.retrieve: Combine current short-term history with retriever.retrieve_context mid/long-term outputs, preserve backend ordering, and let the common WMA answer generator consume the normalized context. Do not call Memoryos.get_response.
adapter_mapping.export_memory_delta: Diff normalized backend identities against the previous per-session snapshot; never infer an update from generated answer text.

observed_semantics: add_memory migrates short-term content before deque insertion when capacity is full.
Memoryos.get_response uses temperature 0.7, generates the final answer, and writes the query/answer back into memory, so it is excluded from the common-answer evaluation path.
retrieve_context searches mid-term and two long-term stores but omits short-term history; the official response path adds short-term separately.
mid-term retrieval increments visit/access state and saves it, so query order is stateful and must remain frozen.
retrieve_context converts any task exception into an empty list; the adapter must expose per-branch errors in raw_trace and reject lifecycle evidence when any branch falls back.
short-, mid-, and long-term persistence catches some write/load errors after printing; the wrapper must verify expected files and parseability independently.
methods.environment_boundary: Use a dedicated Python 3.9 environment. Preserve sentence-transformers==5.0.0 and numpy==1.24.*; resolve and hash all transitive versions. A faiss-cpu substitution for unavailable faiss-gpu packaging is permitted only if frozen before execution and verified to retain IndexFlatIP behavior.
methods.lifecycle_minimum: At least 12 ordered user/assistant pairs are required so the test crosses the default short-term capacity, exercises LLM-backed migration, persists short and mid term, reconstructs from disk, and retrieves before and after reconstruction.

adapter_mapping.reset: Construct MemGASMemory with a fresh per-run storage directory and no pre-existing memory_state.pt.
adapter_mapping.ingest_turn: Buffer normalized turn text and attachment-caption provenance by session; do not create a memory record per turn.
adapter_mapping.end_session: Call add once with the complete ordered session and conversation_id equal to the WMA session_id, retaining WMA source identities in metadata.
adapter_mapping.snapshot_memories: Normalize MemoryStore.records and include all five stored embedding granularities only as metadata counts/dimensions, not raw vectors.
adapter_mapping.retrieve: Call retrieve with conversation_id unset so questions may search all completed sessions, default mode memgas, and the frozen top_k.
adapter_mapping.export_memory_delta: Emit one add for each new backend memory_id and no synthetic updates.

observed_semantics: Each completed session triggers two internal LLM calls for summary and keywords and five Contriever encoding passes.
The official LLM client makes up to three attempts per internal request; these attempts are method semantics and must be logged separately from prohibited unit reruns.
Retrieval uses entropy routing, a similarity graph, and personalized PageRank over session, turn, summary, and keyword nodes.

GaussianMixture edge selection catches every exception and silently falls back to the highest-similarity edge; the execution overlay must count and disclose this fallback without changing its returned edge.
MemoryStore persists records and embeddings with torch.save and loads with torch.load.

The repository tracks eight quickstart/__pycache__/*.cpython-39.pyc files. An immutable execution copy must exclude them and run with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 so audited source text is authoritative.
methods.reproducibility_overlay: A minimal hashed overlay may replace only the hard-coded facebook/contriever identifier with the frozen local model path and wrap _select_edges to count exceptions while preserving the same top-1 fallback. Any other algorithm change is prohibited.
methods.environment_boundary: Use a dedicated Python 3.9 quickstart environment. Install only imported runtime dependencies, retain official pins where compatible, and freeze the resolved lock. Do not require vLLM or flash-attn inside this client environment because the LLM is an external OpenAI-compatible service.
methods.lifecycle_minimum: Use at least three completed sessions, persist and reconstruct memory_state.pt, exercise default memgas retrieval with enough candidate nodes to invoke GMM selection, verify finite scores, and require an explicit fallback counter.

shared_answer_boundary: Neither method may generate the scored final answer. The same frozen WMA answer model, prompt, decoding settings, sample order, and evaluator used by other baselines consume the normalized retrieved context.
multimodal_claim_boundary: Both implementations are caption-mediated text-memory baselines. Image bytes are retained for provenance but are not encoded by these methods; results must be labeled caption-mediated and cannot support a native multimodal-memory claim.
decision: ACCEPT both methods for separate model, environment, overlay, and lifecycle prefreezes.
next_allowed_gate: Freeze and materialize exact embedding snapshots only after Wave-1 releases its service stack; then construct isolated environments and execute one lifecycle gate per method before any full numerical run.
prohibited_actions: calling Memoryos.get_response in the WMA scoring path
forcing MemoryOS long-term analysis at session end
silently ignoring MemoryOS retrieval branch errors or persistence failures
loading MemGAS tracked bytecode instead of audited source text
changing MemGAS graph, routing, GMM, PageRank, embedding, or retry semantics in the reproducibility overlay
claiming native image-memory support for either method
starting model download, GPU lifecycle, or numerical execution while Wave-1 is active
